notes.title: Sniffer goes to Tokyo Game Show 2025
notes.content:
🎌 Tokyo Game Show 2025
We’re excited to share that Tiny Nomads will be part of Tokyo Game Show 2025, taking place September 25–28 in Chiba, Japan. TGS is one of the largest video game expos in the world, uniting creators, players, publishers, and innovators from across the industry.
👃 Representing Sniffer's Delight
At the show, we’ll be presenting our debut game, Nasal Nomad: Sniffer’s Delight. In Sniffer’s Delight you play as Sniffer, a runny nose with snotty legs & toes! Harness unlockable breathing and snot-related abilities to sneeze, sniff, and snot through the strange sewers of Scentropolis to restore order one smell at a time. Befriend quirky characters and find your way back to the surface where your human awaits.

Our goal at Tokyo Game Show is not just to let more players experience Sniffer’s wild adventure, but also to connect with potential collaborators, publishers, investors, marketers, and researchers who share our vision for bold and unconventional games.
👋 Come Say Hi! 
If you’re attending TGS, come say hello at Sweden Game Arena! Whether you want to try Nasal Nomad: Sniffer’s Delight, chat with us about the game’s development, or explore possible collaborations, we’d love to meet you.
See you in Tokyo, and check out our new trailer! With the features and mechanics! ːsteamhappyː[previewyoutube="_pjTStYrBQU;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Gotland Game Conference 2025
notes.content:
Tiny Nomads | GGC 2025
We are going to Visby as judges for Gotland Game Conference 2025. Held at the game design campus that started the game development journey for Tiny Nomads.

We will attend as judges to play, review and score the game made by the university students of Campus Gotland. We are very excited to come back, talk with the students and teachers, as well as experience the beauty of Visby once again.

Will you be there? Reach out to us - Let's talk! contact@tinynomads.studio

Where?
Visby, Gotland
Sweden 

When?
9-11th of June, 2025
